translations.source_sense_description: остающийся с живой листвой, хвоей в течение всего года (о растениях)

glosses: Of plants, especially trees, that do not shed their leaves seasonally.

examples.text: Near-synonym: nondeciduous

...these three little creeping vines put forth their hands with joy, and spread over rock and hillock and twisted tree-root and mouldering log, in cloaks and scarves and wreaths of tiny evergreen, glossy leaves.

glosses: Continually fresh or self-renewing.
Being a clause which causes an automatic renewal of a contract unless action is taken.
Continually fresh or self-renewing.
Of a document, a piece of software, or a data set: kept continually up to date (as opposed to being published at regular intervals and outdated in the meantime)

examples.text: Chrome and Firefox are evergreen browsers: they update automatically and version numbers are only used for internal reference.

glosses: Suitable for transmission at any time; not urgent or time-dependent.

examples.text: Another change in the news was emphasis on “evergreen” features involving attractive children or animals, parades or fireworks, as well as local developments.

glosses: A shrub or tree that does not shed its leaves or needles seasonally.

examples.text: The lawn before them was gay with evergreens, relieved by the first few flowers and fresh turf of the reviving Spring; […]

Husband and wife walked till they had reached the house they were in search of, which stood in a terrace facing the sea, and was fronted by a small garden of wind-proof and salt-proof evergreens, stone steps leading up to the porch.

glosses: A conifer tree.

examples.text: The spruce and fir trees crowded to the track on each side to welcome us, the arbor- vitae, with its changing leaves, prompted us to make haste, and the sight of the canoe-birch gave us spirits to do so. glosses: A news story that can be published or broadcast at any time.
